title: Infinite Water Block
description: Add an infinite water block and an infinite liquid block for minecraft 1.7.10.
body:
The 1.7.10 Infinite Water Mod adds an Infinite Water Block, which outputs vanilla water to the containers and pipes on its six adjacent sides every Tick, at a rate equal to the maximum value of Java's 4-byte integer (Integer).

Updated an Infinite Fluid Block — its default output type is water. You can change the output fluid type to the one held in the container by holding a fluid container (e.g., a Lava Bucket) and right-clicking the block. Right-clicking it with an empty hand will display the current output fluid type and rate in the chat window, while sneaking and right-clicking with an empty hand cycles through the output rates.
The output fluid type and rate are saved in the block’s item NBT data; mining the block and placing it again will not alter the output fluid.

Supports GregTech 6 (GT6); the output fluid type can be set by right-clicking the block with a GT6 Block Tank.Supports IndustrialCraft 2 (IC2); the output fluid type can be set by right-clicking the block with an IC2 Universal Fluid Cell.
